---
title: "Taper"
sidebar: api
---

`taper` creates a CPW transition between two conductor widths and gap sizes.
The default keeps the gap at 6 µm while changing the conductor width from 10 µm
to 7 µm.

## Build the default component

```python
import gdsfactory as gf
from orcapen_sc_pdk import activate

activate()
component = gf.get_component("taper")
```

## Parameters

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width1`, `width2` | 10 µm, 7 µm | Conductor widths at the two ends. |
| `gap1`, `gap2` | 6 µm, 6 µm | CPW gap sizes at the two ends. |
| `length` | 100 µm | Transition length. |

## Ports and layers

The route ports are `o_taper_in` and `o_taper_out`, both on the DRAW conductor.
The factory creates DRAW, GROUND_MASK, and derived ETCH geometry. See the
[pinned public source](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/0bd9a9e1e8e21d6519f22373f20ef5ce22772a5b/orcapen_sc_pdk/cells/layout/taper.py)
for the layer and port definitions.
